AURIC × MFM10 / 23
Case study · Identity & content

ELK Café. One look for a whole season.

Client work · 2025 · Saudi Arabia
The challenge

Celebrate Saudi National Day with offers that feel part of the moment, not a generic sale, with one look for all of September.

What we made

A National Day system built around the line «عزّنا بطبعنا»: a Sadu-inspired magenta band, warm photography of ELK’s own drinks and bold Arabic headlines, laid out week by week.

DeliveredNational Day look & line3 feed posts5 storiesFeed grid planSeptember content plan
